name: Uonuma (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Uonuma city emblem in green and yellow: a green ring open at the hoist with a row of yellow discs.
history: Municipal flag of Uonuma, a city in Niigata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 28 March 2005.

features.role: Uonuma city emblem — a green ring open at the hoist with a row of yellow discs
